AGENT: Santhosham! Ningalude abhiprayam kettu nannaayi. Njan ivideyannoru sahayam cheyyan venengil, chothikkuka. Nanni!
CUSTOMER: Nanni! Enikku matheyaanum chodhikkan venam, clinic il parking facility undu?
AGENT: Clinic-il parking facility undu. Ningalude visit time-yil parking neengal udheshichu koodi saadhyam kaanikkum. Sugamayi varuka! Angane chothikkuka enthaayalum, njan ivide anu!
CUSTOMER: Nanni! Parking facility kaanan sadhyamakum, sughamayi varam. Thank you!

CUSTOMER: Nanni! Njan chothikkam, ivide santhoshamakum! Sugamayi varum!
AGENT: Ningalude upadeshathinu nanni! Sugamayi varuka! Enikku sahayikkan sadhikkunna ethuvenkilum prashnangal undeengil, chothikkuka. Nanni!
